goal: Make canonical repository publication safely reusable from isolated consumer worktrees without weakening fail-closed staging or remote verification.
acceptance_criteria: Consumer .cgnk governance files are current governance, while .cgkn remains local state.
Drizzle SQL migrations require explicit review.
Environment credential references are not false-positive secrets and literal secrets remain blocked.
Detached worktree publication requires explicit target branch and exact remote baseline equality.
Canonical SourceIdentity, manifest, receipt, exact staging, non-force push, and fetched remote equality remain mandatory.
Test and post-commit command output plus CLI receipts use UTF-8 with replacement on Windows.
Publication runtime state cannot invalidate the SourceIdentity to which its own receipt is bound.

quality_metrics.measure: required consumer governance/source paths classified UNKNOWN or falsely SECRET
quality_metrics.method: canonical publisher unit tests and Attune manifest preflight

quality_metrics.measure: detached publication capable of overwriting a changed target branch

prevention: Keep consumer governance, local state, migrations, and secrets as distinct classifier roles
assurance: Add positive and negative classifier tests plus detached target-branch publication coverage
control: Run publisher, source identity, kernel contract, and canonical version gates before publication
improvement: Exercise the repaired gate against the real isolated Attune reconstruction

interface_expectations: canonical_repo_publish.py remains the only repository publication authority
Consumer version validation is explicit and command-bound
Normal push and fetched remote SHA equality remain mandatory
Provider and product-delivery authorities remain unchanged
evidence_refs: 80 canonical publisher, source identity, kernel contract, and release-candidate tests
Attune isolated-worktree manifest preflight: 45 COMMIT, 0 REVIEW, 0 BLOCKED

feedback: Consumer governance, migration review, credential-reference handling, explicit version validation, and detached target-branch publication are fail-closed and covered by tests.

worked: Testing the canonical gate against the real isolated Attune worktree exposed consumer-boundary gaps before publication.
Explicit repository root, version command, and target branch preserved exact source and remote identity checks.
The real Windows consumer run exposed locale-dependent subprocess and CLI-output encoding before Attune publication.
The consumer receipt run exposed publication runtime state feeding back into SourceIdentity when the consumer did not ignore .cgkn.
did_not_work: Repository-specific path and secret heuristics were too narrow for governed consumer publication.
Implicit locale encoding made UTF-8 test output and receipt printing unsafe on a GBK host.
SourceIdentity originally treated its own unignored .cgkn/publish artifacts as consumer source state.
experiments: Keep a consumer-worktree publication scenario in the canonical publisher regression suite.
